name: osaurus
title: Osaurus
description: Use local Osaurus models in Raycast AI, ask them directly, manage them, and search chat history
author: chrismessina

preferences.name: osaurusApp
preferences.title: Osaurus App
preferences.description: Which Osaurus to open when none is running. Empty reopens the last one.

preferences.name: verboseLogging
preferences.title: Debug Logging
preferences.label: Enable extra diagnostics in the console
preferences.description: Show detailed logs in the console for debugging.

preferences.name: strictRedaction
preferences.title: Strict Redaction
preferences.label: Also hide URL query strings and fragments in logs
preferences.description: Turn on before reproducing an issue, then share only the new log lines.

commands.name: ask-osaurus
commands.title: Ask Osaurus
commands.description: Send a prompt to a local model and stream the answer

commands.name: manage-models
commands.title: Manage Models
commands.description: Browse your Osaurus models, set the one Ask Osaurus uses, and open or quit Osaurus

commands.name: search-models
commands.title: Search Models
commands.description: Search Hugging Face for MLX models, or paste a link, and add one to Osaurus

commands.name: search-history
commands.title: Search History
commands.description: Search past Osaurus chats by title and message text

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
